scope: Visible right-hand skin regression in six non-weapon actions; not whole animation approval.
baseline: Pre-rebuild v007 GIFs exported 2026-10-21 10:42 UTC; global-palette quantization present. No pixel-lossless baseline claim. v006 neutral reference is supplementary only.
sampling: Same source tick selected at each quantized GIF time-bin center; 30Hz, original 1x clock.

shared_baseline_palette_comparison.method: Quantize current PNG to the preserved GIF global palette with dither NONE, then compare at each source time-bin center. This controls palette differences but does not reconstruct pre-rebuild lossless PNG colors.
